rationale: The R09 candidate preserves the R05 substantive body after revision-label normalization. The only content-like addition is repeating the existing six-column header in a second table (layout split after the fourth data row into two five-row tables). All eight checklist item IDs (SYN-0117-COHORT-BASE, SYN-0117-COHORT-CURR, SYN-0117-CERT-SPEC, SYN-0117-FIRST-RESULTS, SYN-0117-RETAKES, SYN-0117-NONATTEMPTS, SYN-0117-CONSENT, SYN-0117-REVIEW) are preserved with their meaning intact. The I19-E04 genre (operational certification/exam outcome tracker) and source boundary are correctly maintained; Section 1.3 explicitly lists 0116/I19-E03 and 0115/I19-E02 as separate, non-overlapping domains. SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC_ONLY labels appear throughout, with the disclaimer that all rows, scores, thresholds and changes are synthetic demonstrations only — not real association performance, causality, or significant evidence. The four metrics (M1 first-sit pass rate, M2 participation rate, M3 eventual 90-day pass rate, M4 eligible pass yield) and their arithmetic are identical to R05: M1 50.0%→62.5% (+12.5pp), M2 75.0%→80.0% (+5.0pp), M3 66.7%→75.0% (+8.3pp), M4 50.0%→60.0% (+10.0pp). Non-attempt/withdrawal handling is correct: NO_ATTEMPT stays in the eligible denominator but not in the valid first-sit denominator; WITHDRAWN is excluded from the cohort per Section 4.1 F5; retakes are tracked at the audit layer and never inflate person counts. No new blocking semantic defect was introduced. The layout fix (removing row-level pageBreakBefore, adding a page break between tables instead) resolves the R08 rendering issue where the header was omitted on page splits. Existing nonblocking notes (0107 boundary, Section 8.5 '本合尤' typo) are reconciled and confirmed nonblocking — they are cosmetic/documentation details, not fundamental arithmetic or hold/reject rule failures.
